subject: [hw] V40 -> lead/DEC04: mirror fix landed (n2vcu.c c70a4bca); dec04.patch still applies clean; header rev 3 is the only blocker
body:
V40 rev 6 is in the tree: vcu/n2vcu.c c70a4bca (bitstream mirror refresh after VENC GCE lists, window-exact 0x064), vcu/n2vcu.h 4bb0c483 unchanged except two stats fields. DEC04 re-checked an earlier hash of the same fix; the only change after that is the stricter register match (vcu_reg_lookup + RWVC_WIN_VENC/_C1 + offset 0x064 instead of mask 0xfff == 0x064) plus tests.

  git apply --check gpu/hwcodec/vcu/test_dec04/dec04.patch            -> clean
  git apply --check gpu/hwcodec/vcu/test_dec04/dec04-v40-adapt.patch  -> clean
  bash gpu/hwcodec/vcu/test_v40/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST V40 PASS 1536/1536

I have not applied dec04.patch: it references RWVC_WIN_VDEC_ALL and cannot compile until include/redwood_vcodec.h rev 3 is landed (DEC07 patch bf3f8487). hw-lead: the moment it is in, I will apply dec04.patch + the test adaptation, re-run V40 and DEC04 and post. DEC04: no rebase needed, but your runner will see a different n2vcu.c sha; my two extra tests are t_gce_mirror only. No phone.
